signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: Add unlimited sites & see how all of them are doing in one simple view.
We can handle tens of billions of pageviews a month with no issues or downtime.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 4 reviews (1.1% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: I wrote an email to support (which they didn't reply to)
contact support, which is woefully slow and will 'lose' your message.
Giving this a 3 taco rating based on no response from customer support

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $288 regular price (73% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to modify or replace these Terms at any time.
If a revision is material we will try to provide at least 30 days notice prior to any new terms taking effect.

claims.text: Product tracks unlimited websites with funnel, visitor streaming and conversion tracking

quote.text: Track UNLIMITED websites. Funnel tracking, visitor streaming, conversion tracking and more!

claims.text: Lifetime access plans available with a one-time payment

quote.text: Yes, Visitor Tracking provides lifetime access plans with a one-time payment.

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: Includes session tracking, portfolio management, conversion tracking, journey mapping, funnel and event tracking

quote.text: Visitor Tracking provides a comprehensive suite of features including session tracking, website portfolio management, conversion tracking, customer journey mapping, funnel tracking, event tracking, and conversion analytics.

claims.text: Can monitor an unlimited number of websites

quote.text: Yes, Visitor Tracking allows you to monitor an unlimited number of websites.

claims.text: Includes event tracking for button clicks, form submissions and other interactions

quote.text: Absolutely. Visitor Tracking includes an Event Tracking feature that lets you monitor specific user actions on your website, such as button clicks, form submissions, and other interactions.

claims.text: If pageview limit is exceeded, user is notified and offered an upgrade to higher pageviews

quote.text: If you surpass your plan's pageview limit, Visitor Tracking will notify you and offer the option to upgrade to a plan that accommodates more pageviews.

claims.text: If not upgrading after exceeding limit, tracking pauses until new month

quote.text: If you choose not to upgrade, tracking will pause until the start of the new month.

claims.text: Customer Journey feature traces entire visitor path from first interaction to conversion

quote.text: Visitor Tracking's Customer Journey feature allows you to trace the entire path of each visitor, from their first interaction to conversion.

claims.text: Funnel tracking monitors each step of sales or marketing funnels

quote.text: Funnel Tracking in Visitor Tracking enables you to monitor each step of your sales or marketing funnels.

claims.text: Plan includes conversions breakdown by source, page, device and UTM

quote.text: Conversions breakdown by source, page, device, UTM and more

claims.text: Setup involves adding a tracking code to website header after signup

quote.text: Setting up Visitor Tracking is straightforward. After signing up, you'll receive a tracking code to add to your website's header.

finePrint.summary: Purchases can be refunded if requested within 7 days for dissatisfaction.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can change the Terms at any time at its sole discretion.

finePrint.summary: Service is provided as-is and as-available without warranty promises.

trials.claim: Lifetime access plans available with a one-time payment
trials.claimQuote: Yes, Visitor Tracking provides lifetime access plans with a one-time payment.
trials.reasoning: A lifetime-deal buyer reports being charged £220 again despite holding an LTD, which directly undercuts the one-time payment promise.

exhibits.quote: This company charge my card today for a 220 pounds even i have a LTD deals
exhibits.argument: A buyer reporting an extra charge despite holding a lifetime deal undermines the one-time payment promise.

exhibits.quote: Lock in today and get 40% off for life!
exhibits.argument: The vendor's own pricing frames for life as a recurring subscription discount, not a one-time lifetime plan.

exhibits.quote: I had always enjoyed Clicky but it becomes expensive on a monthly payment so I was thrilled to get an LTD with Visitor Tracking.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms they obtained Visitor Tracking as an LTD instead of a monthly payment.

trials.claim: Product tracks unlimited websites with funnel, visitor streaming and conversion tracking
trials.claimQuote: Track UNLIMITED websites. Funnel tracking, visitor streaming, conversion tracking and more!
trials.reasoning: Buyers report conversions were not working at all and that there is no unlimited tier, conflicting with the promised unlimited tracking and conversion features.

exhibits.quote: Conversions - these were simply not working at all.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reporting conversions completely non-functional contradicts the promised conversion tracking.

exhibits.quote: This and the lack of an unlimited tier means I am giving my first ever 1 star review.
exhibits.argument: A buyer explicitly citing the lack of an unlimited tier undermines the unlimited tracking claim.

exhibits.quote: Add unlimited sites & see how all of them are doing in one simple view.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states users can add unlimited sites viewed in one place.

exhibits.quote: Track by page, event, or full funnel tracking
exhibits.argument: The vendor states conversion tracking includes page, event and full funnel tracking.

trials.claim: Can monitor an unlimited number of websites
trials.claimQuote: Yes, Visitor Tracking allows you to monitor an unlimited number of websites.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states users can add as many websites as they like and view unlimited sites together, and the prosecution exhibits concern pageview limits or a single tracking failure rather than a limit on number of sites.

exhibits.quote: If you decide not to upgrade, it's okay, but we won't be able to track your site's activity until the start of the new month.
exhibits.argument: Admitting tracking stops entirely shows monitoring is not truly unlimited.

exhibits.quote: the stats are not tracking live visitors, after I added the website and installed the tracking code
exhibits.argument: A buyer reporting added websites fail to track contradicts the ability to monitor websites.

exhibits.quote: Absolutely! You have the freedom to add as many websites as you like.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms users can add as many websites as they like.

exhibits.quote: Add unlimited sites & see how all of them are doing in one simple view.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms unlimited sites can be added and monitored together.

trials.claim: If pageview limit is exceeded, user is notified and offered an upgrade to higher pageviews
trials.claimQuote: If you surpass your plan's pageview limit, Visitor Tracking will notify you and offer the option to upgrade to a plan that accommodates more pageviews.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states over-limit users will get a heads-up and the choice to upgrade to a plan supporting more pageviews, matching the claim.

exhibits.quote: In that case, we'll give you a heads-up and offer you the choice to upgrade to a plan that supports more pageviews.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states over-limit users get a heads-up and a choice to upgrade for more pageviews.

trials.claim: If not upgrading after exceeding limit, tracking pauses until new month
trials.claimQuote: If you choose not to upgrade, tracking will pause until the start of the new month.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states that if you decline to upgrade, it won't be able to track your site's activity until the start of the new month, matching the claim.

exhibits.quote: If you decide not to upgrade, it's okay, but we won't be able to track your site's activity until the start of the new month.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states declining an upgrade means tracking pauses until the start of the new month.

trials.claim: Includes session tracking, portfolio management, conversion tracking, journey mapping, funnel and event tracking
trials.claimQuote: Visitor Tracking provides a comprehensive suite of features including session tracking, website portfolio management, conversion tracking, customer journey mapping, funnel tracking, event tracking, and conversion analytics.
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports conversions were not working at all, and the vendor says visitor session recordings are still on its roadmap, so the claimed comprehensive suite is not fully included or working.

exhibits.quote: Conversions - these were simply not working at all.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reporting conversions completely non-functional contradicts the claimed comprehensive conversion tracking suite.

exhibits.quote: On our roadmap is also recordings of visitor sessions and heatmaps.
exhibits.argument: Stating session recordings are still on the roadmap shows the full tracking suite is not yet included.

exhibits.quote: Track by page, event, or full funnel tracking
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms page, event and full funnel tracking are included.

exhibits.quote: The Live Visitor Stream and Customer Journey Tracking are pure gold—they show you exactly how people interact with your site, their acquisition source, and where they drop off in your funnel.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms live visitor stream, customer journey tracking and funnel drop-off visibility work as promised.
